title: Deductible Options and Zone V Deductibles of the BizFlood Commercial Flood Program
content:
Deductibles on BizFlood Commercial Flood Policies (Surplus Lines) are set per location per occurrence. Each tier offers a set of flat deductible options with a lowest permitted flat deductible, and fixes a percentage-of-location-value deductible, with its own minimum, for a location in flood zone V or VE. All amounts are in USD.

## Flat deductible options

| Tier | Lowest flat deductible per location | Flat deductible options per location |
|---|---|---|
| BizFlood Building | 5000 | 5000, 10000, 25000, 50000, 100000 |
| BizFlood Building and Contents | 5000 | 5000, 10000, 25000, 50000, 100000 |
| BizFlood Building, Contents and Business Income | 5000 | 5000, 10000, 25000, 50000, 100000 |
| BizFlood Excess over NFIP | 5000 | 5000, 10000, 25000, 50000, 100000 |
| BizFlood Multi-Location | 5000 | 5000, 10000, 25000, 50000, 100000 |
| BizFlood Large Property | 25000 | 25000, 50000, 100000, 250000 |

## Zone V and VE deductible

| Tier | Percentage of location value | Minimum zone V deductible |
|---|---|---|
| BizFlood Building | 5 | 25000 |
| BizFlood Building and Contents | 5 | 25000 |
| BizFlood Building, Contents and Business Income | 5 | 25000 |
| BizFlood Excess over NFIP | 5 | 25000 |
| BizFlood Multi-Location | 5 | 25000 |
| BizFlood Large Property | 5 | 100000 |

## Notes to the schedule

- BizFlood Large Property starts its flat options at 25000 and adds a 250000 option; it does not offer 5000 or 10000.
- The zone V percentage is 5 percent on every tier; the minimum is 25000 on five tiers and 100000 on BizFlood Large Property.

## Illustration (hypothetical location values)

On a tier with a 5 percent zone V deductible and a 25000 minimum, a hypothetical zone VE location valued at 300,000 at the time of loss yields 5 percent of 300,000, that is 15,000, which is below the minimum, so the deductible is 25,000; a hypothetical zone VE location valued at 900,000 yields 45,000, which is above the minimum, so the deductible is 45,000.
